exercises.name: Bench Press (Barbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Take a grip a little wider than your shoulders and lift the bar out of the rack.
Lower the bar under control to your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked about 45 degrees from your body.
Press the bar back up over your shoulders until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell on each thigh, then lie back and bring them to chest height.
Start with the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing your feet.
Lower them slowly until your elbows sit just below the bench, keeping your wrists over your elbows.
Press the dumbbells back up and slightly together until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set a flat bench under the smith bar so the bar lines up with your lower chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and twist it to unhook.
Lower the bar to your chest with control, elbows angled about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms and re-hook the bar when the set is done.

exercises.name: Paused Bench Press (Barbell)
instructions: Set up exactly as for a regular bench press and unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your chest and let it settle there for a full one to two seconds without bouncing.
Keep your upper back tight and your feet pressed into the floor during the pause.
Drive the bar back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Bench Press (Barbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and take an underhand grip about shoulder width apart. Use a spotter for this lift.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your shoulders with straight arms.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, letting your elbows stay close to your sides.
Press back up along the same path until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Barbell)
instructions: Set the bench to about 30 to 45 degrees and lie back with your eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your upper chest, just below the collarbones.
Press the bar back up until it is over your shoulders with straight arms.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Set the bench to a 30 to 45 degree incline and lie back holding a dumbbell at each shoulder.
Press the dumbbells up over your upper chest.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your upper chest, keeping your forearms vertical.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Smith Machine)
instructions: Place an incline bench under the smith bar so the bar meets your upper chest.
Grip slightly wider than your shoulders and unhook the bar.
Lower it under control to your upper chest.
Press back to straight arms and re-hook the bar at the end of the set.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Barbell)
instructions: Secure your legs in the decline bench and lie back with the bar over your eyes.
Unrack the bar with a grip slightly wider than your shoulders. A spotter is strongly recommended.
Lower the bar to your lower chest under control.
Press it back up until your arms are straight over your chest.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hook your legs into a decline bench and lie back holding the dumbbells against your chest.
Press the dumbbells up over your lower chest.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your chest.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Smith Machine)
instructions: Position a decline bench under the smith bar so it lines up with your lower chest.
Secure your legs, grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and unhook it.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, then press it back to straight arms.
Re-hook the bar before sitting up.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Barbell)
instructions: Lie on the floor under a bar set low in a rack, knees bent or legs straight.
Unrack the bar with a shoulder-width grip and hold it over your chest.
Lower it until your upper arms rest on the floor, pausing briefly.
Press back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand and your knees bent.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor, then pause.
Press back up without bouncing your elbows off the floor.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Kettlebell)
instructions: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell in each hand with the bells resting on the back of your wrists.
Press the kettlebells straight up over your chest.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor, keeping your wrists straight.
Press back up to the start.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest.
Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight without locking your elbows hard.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Press (Machine)
instructions: Set the seat so the handles start level with your upper chest.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are straight.
Control the handles back until your hands are just in front of your shoulders.
Keep your shoulder blades against the pad throughout.

exercises.name: Decline Chest Press (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your lower chest.
Grip the handles and press down and forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly to the start, keeping your back against the pad.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Cable)
instructions: Set both pulleys around chest height and stand in the middle holding a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance and bring the handles beside your chest.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight and your hands meet.
Return slowly until your hands are back beside your chest.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and press two dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
With a slight bend in your elbows, open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop when you feel a stretch across your chest and your hands are about level with the bench.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest along the same arc.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
instructions: Set the bench to a 30 degree incline and hold the dumbbells over your upper chest.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows and lower the weights out to the sides.
Stop at a comfortable stretch, then squeeze them back together over your chest.

exercises.name: Decline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench and hold the dumbbells over your lower chest.
With slightly bent elbows, open your arms out to the sides.
Lower until you feel a stretch, then bring the dumbbells back together.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height when your arms are out to the sides.
Sit tall with your back against the pad and hold the handles with slightly bent elbows.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a wide arc.
Open back up slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Cable)
instructions: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance with your arms out to the sides and a slight bend in your elbows.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in a hugging motion.
Return slowly until your arms are back out to the sides.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly (Cable)
instructions: Set both pulleys at the lowest position and hold a handle in each hand.
Stand in a split stance with your arms down and slightly behind you.
Sweep your hands up and together until they meet in front of your upper chest.
Lower them back down slowly along the same path.

exercises.name: High-to-Low Cable Fly (Cable)
instructions: Set both pulleys above head height and hold a handle in each hand.
Lean forward slightly from a split stance with your arms out and up.
Bring your hands down and together in front of your hips.
Let them rise back to the start under control.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Fly (Cable)
instructions: Place an incline bench between two low pulleys and lie back holding a handle in each hand.
Start with your arms out to the sides and a slight bend in your elbows.
Bring the handles together over your upper chest.
Lower them back out slowly until you feel a stretch.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Fly (Cable)
instructions: Set a pulley at shoulder height and stand side-on to it, holding the handle with the near hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow and sweep the handle across your body to the middle of your chest.
Return slowly until your arm is back out to the side.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders and step your feet back.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels and brace your stomach.
Lower your chest to just above the floor with your elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands on a bench or box slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge of the bench, then push back up.
Use a higher surface to make it easier and a lower one to make it harder.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: Put your feet on a bench or box and your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest towards the floor, then push back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Push-Up
instructions: Set your hands about one and a half times shoulder width apart in a push-up position.
Brace your stomach and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest towards the floor, then press back up.

exercises.name: Knee Push-Up
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Shift forward so your body forms a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your chest to the floor, then push back up.

exercises.name: Archer Push-Up
instructions: Set up in a push-up with your hands placed very wide.
Lower your body towards one hand while the other arm stays nearly straight.
Push back up to the middle and repeat to the other side.

exercises.name: Clap Push-Up
instructions: Start in a strong push-up position.
Lower your chest, then push up explosively so your hands leave the floor.
Clap quickly and land with soft elbows, going straight into the next rep.

exercises.name: Push-Up (Weighted)
instructions: Have a partner place a weight plate on your upper back, or wear a weight vest.
Set up in a push-up with your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to just above the floor and push back up.
Keep your hips from sagging under the extra load.

exercises.name: Ring Push-Up (Suspension)
instructions: Set the handles a few centimetres off the floor and hold them in a push-up position.
Keep your body straight and the handles steady under your shoulders.
Lower your chest between your hands, then press back up and squeeze the handles together at the top.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Suspension)
instructions: Face away from the anchor, holding the handles out in front at chest height and leaning forward.
With slightly bent elbows, open your arms out to the sides as your body lowers.
Squeeze your chest to bring your hands back together and return to the start.
Step your feet back to make it harder.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Band)
instructions: Anchor a band behind you at chest height and hold an end in each hand.
Step forward until there is tension, hands beside your chest.
Press your hands forward until your arms are straight, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Band)
instructions: Anchor a band behind you at chest height and hold an end in each hand with arms out to the sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Open back up slowly against the band's pull.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms.
Lean your torso forward slightly and let your elbows flare a little.
Lower yourself until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Chest Dip (Weighted)
instructions: Attach weight to a dip belt or wear a weight vest, then support yourself on the bars.
Lean slightly forward and lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms without swinging.

exercises.name: Chest Dip (Assisted)
instructions: Set the assistance weight on the machine; more weight means more help.
Kneel or stand on the pad and grip the dip handles with straight arms.
Lean slightly forward and lower until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Press back up to the start.

exercises.name: Svend Press (Plate)
instructions: Stand tall and squeeze one or two plates together between your palms in front of your chest.
Press the plates straight out in front of you while squeezing them together hard.
Bring them back to your chest slowly, keeping the squeeze the whole time.

exercises.name: Pullover (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie across or along a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and lower the dumbbell back behind your head.
Stop at a comfortable stretch, then pull it back over your chest.

exercises.name: Squeeze Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and press two dumbbells together over your chest, palms facing each other.
Keep the dumbbells pressed together hard and lower them to your chest.
Press back up while maintaining the squeeze.

exercises.name: Around the World (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your hips, palms up.
Keeping your arms nearly straight, sweep the dumbbells out and up in a wide arc until they meet over your head.
Reverse the arc back down to your hips.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass (Medicine Ball)
instructions: Stand facing a solid wall about two metres away, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Step forward and push the ball powerfully into the wall from your chest.
Catch it on the rebound with soft arms and reset for the next rep.

exercises.name: Plate Press (Plate)
instructions: Stand tall holding a plate at chest height with both hands on its edges.
Press the plate straight out in front of you until your arms are straight.
Bring it back to your chest slowly.

exercises.name: Overhead Press (Barbell)
instructions: Stand with the bar resting on the front of your shoulders, hands just outside shoulder width.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes so your lower back stays neutral.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head back slightly so it clears your chin.
Finish with the bar over the middle of your feet and your arms locked, then lower it to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Press (Barbell)
instructions: Sit on an upright bench with the bar racked just above shoulder height.
Unrack the bar with a grip slightly wider than your shoulders and hold it at your upper chest.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your upper chest under control.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit on an upright bench holding a dumbbell at each shoulder, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight, letting them come slightly together.
Lower them back to shoulder height slowly.

exercises.name: Standing Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart and a dumbbell at each shoulder.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Press the dumbbells overhead without leaning back, then lower them to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles start at about shoulder height.
Sit with your back against the pad and grip the handles.
Press up until your arms are straight, then lower slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Smith Machine)
instructions: Place an upright bench under the smith bar so the bar comes down just in front of your face.
Grip slightly wider than your shoulders and unhook the bar.
Lower it to about chin level, then press back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Kettlebell)
instructions: Clean a kettlebell to the rack position, with the bell resting on the outside of your forearm.
Brace your stomach and press the bell straight overhead, turning your palm forward as it rises.
Lower it back to the rack position under control.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Overhead Press (Band)
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band and hold an end in each hand at shoulder height.
Press your hands overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders slowly.

exercises.name: Arnold Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit on an upright bench holding the dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
As you press up, rotate your palms so they face forward at the top.
Reverse the rotation as you lower back to the start.

exercises.name: Push Press (Barbell)
instructions: Stand with the bar on the front of your shoulders and your hands just outside shoulder width.
Dip a few centimetres by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up hard through your legs and use that momentum to press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders, absorbing it with your knees.

exercises.name: Landmine Press (Barbell)
instructions: Wedge one end of a barbell into a corner or landmine holder and hold the other end at your shoulder.
Stand in a split stance and brace your stomach.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight, then lower it to your shoulder.
Switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Z Press (Barbell)
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight out in front of you and the bar on the front of your shoulders.
Sit tall and brace your stomach without leaning back.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight, then lower it to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and raise your hips so your body forms an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head towards the floor between your hands.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Handstand Push-Up
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower your head slowly towards the floor, keeping your body tight.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Practise pike push-ups first, and use a pad under your head.

exercises.name: Wall Walk
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your feet against the base of a wall.
Walk your feet up the wall while walking your hands back towards it.
Go as close to the wall as you can control, then walk back out to the start.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell at each side with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until your hands reach shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back to your sides.

exercises.name: Seated Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench holding a dumbbell at each side.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders.
Lower them slowly, without swinging your torso.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Cable)
instructions: Set a pulley at the lowest position and stand side-on to it, holding the handle with the far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side until your hand reaches shoulder height.
Lower it slowly back across your body.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot points.
Place your arms against the pads and raise them out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly back to the start.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Band)
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band and hold an end in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly against the band's pull.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding the dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Raise them straight in front of you to shoulder height with a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower them back down slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Barbell)
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Raise the bar straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower it back to your thighs under control.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Cable)
instructions: Set a pulley at the lowest position and stand facing away from it with the handle between your legs.
Raise your arm straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, then repeat.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Plate)
instructions: Hold a weight plate by its sides at arm's length in front of your thighs.
Raise it straight in front of you to eye level.
Lower it back down slowly.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Band)
instructions: Stand on a band and hold the ends in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and raise your arms in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly against the band's pull.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hinge forward at your hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, holding the dumbbells under your chest.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your upper back at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Machine)
instructions: Sit facing the pad of a fly machine with the handles set to the rear delt position.
Grip the handles with straight arms at shoulder height.
Pull the handles back in a wide arc until your arms are in line with your body.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Cable)
instructions: Set two pulleys at shoulder height and cross the cables, holding the left cable in your right hand and the right in your left.
With straight arms in front of you, pull your hands out and back until they line up with your shoulders.
Return slowly to the crossed position.

exercises.name: Reverse Fly (Suspension)
instructions: Face the anchor holding the handles in front of you with straight arms, leaning back.
Open your arms out to the sides, pulling your chest up towards the anchor.
Lower yourself back slowly. Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart (Band)
instructions: Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height with straight arms and hands shoulder width apart.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides until it touches your chest.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Face Pull (Cable)
instructions: Attach a rope to a pulley set at upper chest height and hold an end in each hand, thumbs towards you.
Step back so there is tension and pull the rope towards your face.
Spread the ends apart and finish with your hands beside your ears and elbows high.
Return slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Face Pull (Band)
instructions: Anchor a band at face height and hold an end in each hand.
Pull the band towards your face, separating your hands and keeping your elbows high.
Return slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Row (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Row the dumbbells up with your elbows flared out wide, about level with your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Barbell)
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip about shoulder width.
Pull the bar up close to your body, leading with your elbows, until it reaches lower chest height.
Lower it back down slowly. Stop lower if you feel any pinch in your shoulders.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding the dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Pull them up along your body, leading with your elbows, until they reach lower chest height.
Lower them back down slowly.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Cable)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand close to it with an overhand grip.
Pull the bar up to lower chest height, leading with your elbows.
Lower it back down slowly.

exercises.name: Incline Y-Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie face down on a bench set to a low incline, holding light dumbbells with your arms hanging down.
With thumbs pointing up, raise your arms forward and out into a Y shape until they line up with your body.
Pause, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: External Rotation (Cable)
instructions: Set a pulley at elbow height and stand side-on to it, holding the handle with the far hand.
Keep your elbow bent at 90 degrees and pinned to your side.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your body, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: External Rotation (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on your side holding a light dumbbell in your top hand, elbow bent at 90 degrees and resting on your side.
Rotate your forearm up towards the ceiling, keeping your elbow against your body.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: External Rotation (Band)
instructions: Anchor a band at elbow height and hold it with the hand farther from the anchor.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side and bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your hand outward against the band, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Bus Driver (Plate)
instructions: Hold a plate by its sides at shoulder height with your arms straight in front of you.
Rotate the plate left and right like turning a steering wheel.
Keep your arms up and count each turn to both sides as one rep.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Halo (Kettlebell)
instructions: Hold a kettlebell upside down by its horns in front of your chest.
Circle it around your head, passing it close behind your neck.
Return to the front and alternate the direction each rep.

exercises.name: Bottoms-Up Press (Kettlebell)
instructions: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle at shoulder height, with the bell pointing up.
Squeeze the handle hard to keep the bell balanced.
Press it overhead slowly, then lower it back to your shoulder.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up (Kettlebell)
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell straight up over your shoulder, with the knee on that side bent.
Roll onto your opposite elbow, then your hand, keeping your eyes on the bell.
Lift your hips, sweep your straight leg under you into a kneeling position, then stand up.
Reverse each step slowly to return to the floor. Each full get-up is one rep.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Landmine Press (Barbell)
instructions: Kneel on one knee beside a landmine and hold the end of the bar at your shoulder with the hand on the side of the down knee.
Brace your stomach and press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Cuban Rotation (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding light dumbbells with your upper arms out to the sides and elbows bent at 90 degrees, forearms pointing down.
Rotate your forearms up until they point to the ceiling, keeping your elbows at shoulder height.
Rotate back down slowly.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Barbell)
instructions: Stand with your mid-foot under the bar and your feet about hip width apart.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your legs, then bend your knees until your shins touch it.
Flatten your back, take a breath and brace, then push the floor away to stand up with the bar close to your legs.
Lock out with your hips and knees together, then lower the bar the same way.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift (Barbell)
instructions: Take a wide stance with your toes turned out and the bar over your mid-foot.
Reach down between your legs and grip the bar with your hands inside your knees.
Push your knees out, lift your chest and brace.
Drive through your feet to stand up, then lower the bar with control.

exercises.name: Deficit Deadlift (Barbell)
instructions: Stand on a low, stable platform, about 3 to 8 centimetres high, with the bar over your mid-foot.
Set up as for a regular deadlift, bending a little further to reach the bar.
Keep your back flat and push the floor away to stand up.
Lower the bar back down with control.

exercises.name: Rack Pull (Barbell)
instructions: Set the bar on the safety pins or blocks at about knee height.
Grip it just outside your legs, flatten your back and brace.
Drive your hips forward to stand up tall with the bar.
Lower it back to the pins under control.

exercises.name: Snatch-Grip Deadlift (Barbell)
instructions: Take a very wide grip on the bar, roughly where it would sit in your hip crease when standing.
Sit your hips lower than a normal deadlift and keep your chest up.
Push through your feet to stand up, keeping the bar close.
Lower it back down with a flat back.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand by your sides or in front of your thighs.
Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to lower the dumbbells towards the floor, keeping your back flat.
Stand back up by driving your hips forward.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Kettlebell)
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Hinge down, grip the handle with both hands and flatten your back.
Stand up tall, squeezing your glutes at the top, then lower the bell back to the floor.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set the smith bar at its lowest stop and stand with the bar over your mid-foot.
Grip just outside your legs, flatten your back and unhook the bar.
Stand up tall, then lower the bar under control along the guide rails.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift (Trap Bar)
instructions: Step into the middle of the trap bar with your feet hip width apart.
Squat down and grip the handles at your sides, keeping your chest up.
Push through your feet to stand tall, then lower the bar back to the floor.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulder blades down, then pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself all the way to straight arms under control.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip well outside your shoulders.
Pull your chest towards the bar, driving your elbows down and out.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from parallel handles with your palms facing each other.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the handles.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip about shoulder width apart.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar, keeping your elbows in front of you.
Lower yourself to straight arms with control.

exercises.name: Pull-Up (Weighted)
instructions: Attach a weight to a dip belt or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Hang from the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull up until your chin is over the bar, then lower to a full hang.

exercises.name: Chin-Up (Weighted)
instructions: Wear a dip belt with added weight and hang from a bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Pull-Up (Assisted)
instructions: Set the assistance weight on the machine; more weight means more help.
Kneel or stand on the platform and take an overhand grip on the handles.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the handles, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Chin-Up (Assisted)
instructions: Select the assistance weight and kneel on the pad.
Grip the handles with your palms facing you.
Pull up until your chin clears the handles, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Pull-Up (Band)
instructions: Loop a resistance band over the bar and place one knee or foot in the loop.
Grip the bar overhand and pull yourself up until your chin is over it.
Lower slowly to straight arms. Use a thinner band as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Negative Pull-Up
instructions: Use a box or jump to get your chin above the bar.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can, aiming for three to five seconds, until your arms are straight.
Step back up and repeat.

exercises.name: Muscle-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with a false grip and generate a small swing.
Pull explosively towards your lower chest, then lean forward and push over the bar.
Press up to straight arms over the bar, then lower back to a hang with control.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Cable)
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs under the pads.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, leaning back only slightly and driving your elbows down.
Let the bar rise back up slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable)
instructions: Attach a close-grip handle and sit with your thighs under the pads.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Return slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable)
instructions: Grip the bar with your palms facing you, about shoulder width apart.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, keeping your chest up.
Let it rise slowly back to the top.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown (Cable)
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and kneel or sit facing it.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, driving your elbow towards your hip.
Return slowly and repeat, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat and thigh pad so you are locked in.
Grip the handles and pull them down towards your upper chest.
Let them return slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Band)
instructions: Anchor a band high above you and kneel facing it, holding an end in each hand.
Pull your hands down to your shoulders, driving your elbows towards your ribs.
Return slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown (Cable)
instructions: Attach a straight bar or rope to a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hinge forward slightly and hold the bar with straight arms at eye level.
Sweep the bar down to your thighs while keeping your arms straight.
Let it rise back up slowly.

exercises.name: Pullover (Cable)
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley, step back and hinge forward slightly with your arms overhead.
Keeping your elbows nearly straight, pull the rope down in an arc to your thighs.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Pullover (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot.
Place your elbows on the pads with your arms overhead.
Push the pads down in an arc towards your stomach, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row (Barbell)
instructions: Hold the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Hinge at your hips until your torso is about 45 degrees or lower, with a flat back and soft knees.
Row the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row (Barbell)
instructions: Set up with the bar on the floor and hinge until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Row the bar explosively to your lower chest without lifting your torso.
Return the bar to the floor and reset before each rep.

exercises.name: Underhand Row (Barbell)
instructions: Hold the bar with an underhand grip about shoulder width apart.
Hinge forward with a flat back and soft knees.
Row the bar to your lower stomach, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower it until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Row both dumbbells to the sides of your stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower them slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Row (Dumbbell)
instructions: Place one knee and the same-side hand on a flat bench, holding a dumbbell in the other hand.
Keep your back flat and pull the dumbbell up towards your hip.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Row the dumbbells up towards your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seal Row (Barbell)
instructions: Lie face down on a high flat bench with the bar on the floor or on blocks underneath.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Row it up until it touches the underside of the bench, then lower it to straight arms.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row (Cable)
instructions: Sit at the row station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Hold the handle with straight arms and sit tall.
Pull the handle to your stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let it return slowly without rounding your back.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Seated Row (Cable)
instructions: Attach a wide bar to the seated row station and grip it overhand, wider than your shoulders.
Sit tall and pull the bar to your lower chest with your elbows flared out.
Return slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Row (Cable)
instructions: Set a pulley at chest height or lower and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand or sit facing the pulley and row the handle to your side.
Return slowly, letting your shoulder reach forward a little, then switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Seated Row (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height and rest your chest on the pad.
Grip the handles and pull them back until your elbows pass your sides.
Return slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row (Machine)
instructions: Stand on the platform and rest your chest against the pad.
Grip the handles and pull them up towards your chest.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row (Barbell)
instructions: Wedge one end of a barbell into a corner or landmine and load the other end.
Straddle the bar, hinge forward with a flat back and hold the bar under the plates with a close handle.
Row the weight to your chest, then lower it to straight arms.

exercises.name: Meadows Row (Barbell)
instructions: Stand side-on to the loaded end of a landmine bar in a staggered stance.
Hinge forward and grip the end of the bar overhand with the hand nearest it.
Row the bar up towards your hip, then lower it slowly. Switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Row (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set the smith bar at knee height and grip it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Hinge forward with a flat back and unhook the bar.
Row it to your lower ribs, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
instructions: Set a bar at about waist height in a rack and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders and hang with your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest to the bar, then lower yourself slowly.
Bend your knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Suspension Row (Suspension)
instructions: Hold the handles facing the anchor and lean back with straight arms.
Keep your body straight and pull your chest up to the handles.
Lower yourself slowly. Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

exercises.name: Row (Band)
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and hold an end in each hand.
Step back until there is tension, then pull your hands to your stomach.
Return slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Row (Kettlebell)
instructions: Place one hand on a bench and hold a kettlebell in the other with a flat back.
Row the bell towards your hip.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Gorilla Row (Kettlebell)
instructions: Stand with two kettlebells on the floor between your feet and hinge forward with a flat back.
Grip both handles and row one bell to your hip while pressing the other into the floor.
Lower it and row the other side. Each side counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Renegade Row (Dumbbell)
instructions: Get into a push-up position holding a dumbbell in each hand, feet wider than your hips.
Row one dumbbell to your hip while keeping your hips square to the floor.
Lower it and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Shrug (Barbell)
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Shrug (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell at each side.
Raise your shoulders straight up towards your ears.
Hold for a moment, then lower them slowly.

exercises.name: Shrug (Machine)
instructions: Stand or sit in the shrug machine and grip the handles.
Lift your shoulders straight up as high as you can.
Pause and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Shrug (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set the smith bar at mid-thigh height and grip it overhand.
Unhook the bar and shrug your shoulders straight up.
Lower slowly and re-hook the bar when done.

exercises.name: Shrug (Trap Bar)
instructions: Stand inside a loaded trap bar and lift it by the handles.
Shrug your shoulders straight up towards your ears.
Pause, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Shrug (Cable)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and hold it in front of your thighs.
Stand tall with your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears.
Pause briefly, then lower them slowly.

exercises.name: Back Extension
instructions: Set yourself in a back extension bench with the pad just below your hips.
Cross your arms over your chest and lower your torso by hinging at your hips.
Raise back up until your body forms a straight line. Avoid arching past straight.

exercises.name: Back Extension (Weighted)
instructions: Set up in a back extension bench and hold a plate against your chest.
Hinge at your hips to lower your torso.
Raise back up until your body is in a straight line.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension (Machine)
instructions: Lie face down on the machine with your hips at the edge of the pad and your ankles under the strap.
Swing your legs up behind you until they are level with your torso.
Lower them under control without letting the weight swing you.

exercises.name: Superman
instructions: Lie face down with your arms stretched out in front of you.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor at the same time.
Hold briefly, then lower back down.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with your back flat.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are straight.
Hold briefly without letting your hips rotate, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Barbell)
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the bar up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top, then lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up while keeping your elbows pinned to your sides.
Lower them slowly to straight arms. You can curl both together or alternate.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (EZ Bar)
instructions: Hold an EZ bar on the inner angled grips with your palms facing up.
Curl the bar to your shoulders without swinging your torso.
Lower it slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Cable)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and hold it with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows by your sides.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the pad and your elbows line up with the pivot.
Grip the handles and curl them towards your shoulders.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Band)
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band and hold an end in each hand, palms forward.
Curl your hands up to your shoulders with your elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly against the band.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Kettlebell)
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns with both hands, or one in each hand by the handle.
Curl the weight up to your chest, keeping your elbows by your sides.
Lower it slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding the dumbbells at your sides with your palms facing each other.
Curl them up while keeping your palms facing in and your elbows still.
Lower them slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding the dumbbells at your sides with palms facing in.
Curl one dumbbell up and across your body towards the opposite shoulder.
Lower it and repeat with the other arm.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl (Cable)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold an end in each hand with palms facing each other.
Curl the rope up towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Incline Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench set to about 45 to 60 degrees with your arms hanging straight down.
Curl the dumbbells up without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower them slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (EZ Bar)
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with the backs of your upper arms flat on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar up towards your shoulders, then lower it until your arms are nearly straight.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (Barbell)
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold a straight bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Curl it up, then lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Rest one upper arm on a preacher bench holding a dumbbell.
Curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder.
Lower it slowly until your arm is nearly straight, then switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your armpits sit at the top of the pad.
Grip the handles and curl them towards your shoulders.
Lower slowly to nearly straight arms.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit on a bench with your legs apart and rest the back of one upper arm against your inner thigh.
Curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder.
Lower it slowly and repeat, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Spider Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with your arms hanging straight down.
Curl the dumbbells up, keeping your upper arms vertical.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Drag Curl (Barbell)
instructions: Hold a barbell with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Curl the bar up while drawing your elbows back so the bar stays in contact with your body.
Lower it along the same path.

exercises.name: Zottman Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Curl the dumbbells up with your palms facing up.
At the top, rotate your palms to face down.
Lower the dumbbells slowly with your palms down, then rotate back at the bottom.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Curl (Cable)
instructions: Stand between two high pulleys holding a handle in each hand with your arms out to the sides.
Curl the handles towards your ears while keeping your upper arms still.
Return slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Behind-the-Body Cable Curl (Cable)
instructions: Set a pulley at the lowest position and stand facing away from it, holding the handle with your arm slightly behind you.
Curl the handle forward and up towards your shoulder.
Lower slowly back behind your body, then switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Waiter Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically by its top end with both palms underneath, like carrying a tray.
Curl it up towards your chin with your elbows close to your sides.
Lower it slowly.

exercises.name: Suspension Curl (Suspension)
instructions: Face the anchor holding the handles with your palms up and lean back with straight arms.
Curl your hands towards your forehead, pulling your body up.
Lower yourself back slowly.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (Barbell)
instructions: Hold a barbell with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Curl the bar up towards your shoulders, keeping your wrists straight.
Lower it slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (EZ Bar)
instructions: Hold an EZ bar with an overhand grip on the angled sections.
Curl the bar up with your elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (Cable)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and hold it overhand.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your wrists straight.
Curl the bar towards your shoulders, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press (Barbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar about shoulder width apart.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Press back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set a flat bench under the smith bar and grip it about shoulder width apart.
Unhook the bar and lower it to your lower chest with your elbows tucked.
Press back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher (EZ Bar)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar over your chest with straight arms.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the bar towards your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher (Barbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a barbell over your chest with a narrow overhand grip.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar towards the top of your head.
Straighten your arms to return to the start.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Extend your arms back up.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown (Cable)
instructions: Attach a straight or angled bar to a high pulley and grip it overhand.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Let the bar rise slowly until your forearms are just above parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: Rope Pushdown (Cable)
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and hold an end in each hand.
With your elbows at your sides, push the rope down and spread the ends apart at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Pushdown (Cable)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and grip it underhand.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Pushdown (Cable)
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and hold it in one hand.
Push it down until your arm is straight, elbow tight to your side.
Return slowly, finish the set, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown (Band)
instructions: Anchor a band high above you and hold it with both hands.
Push your hands down until your arms are straight, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit or stand holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands under the top plate.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head, keeping your upper arms close to your ears.
Extend your arms back overhead.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Overhead Extension (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell overhead in one hand.
Lower it behind your head by bending your elbow, keeping your upper arm still.
Extend back up, then switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Cable)
instructions: Attach a rope to a pulley, face away from it and hold the rope behind your head.
Step forward into a split stance with your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms overhead and forward, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (EZ Bar)
instructions: Sit on an upright bench holding an EZ bar overhead with a narrow grip.
Lower it behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms back to the start.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Band)
instructions: Stand on one end of a band and hold the other end behind your head with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing up and close to your head.
Extend your arms overhead, then lower slowly behind your head.

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding a dumbbell with your upper arm tucked against your side.
Straighten your elbow to push the dumbbell back until your arm is fully extended.
Lower it slowly without moving your upper arm.

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback (Cable)
instructions: Set a pulley at the lowest position and hold the cable without a handle or with a single grip.
Hinge forward and tuck your upper arm against your side.
Extend your arm straight back, then return slowly. Switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and your body upright.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows, keeping them pointing back.
Stop when your upper arms are about parallel to the floor, then press back up.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip (Weighted)
instructions: Add weight with a dip belt or weight vest and support yourself on the bars.
Keep your torso upright and lower until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the dip machine with your back against the pad and grip the handles.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until your elbows are bent about 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands beside your hips and slide forward off the edge.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips towards the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight. Bend your knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Set up in a push-up with your hands close together under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Lower your chest to your hands, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Push back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine's pivot and rest on the pad.
Grip the handles and extend your arms until they are straight.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (Suspension)
instructions: Face away from the anchor holding the handles above your head with bent elbows, leaning forward.
Straighten your arms to push your body back up.
Bend your elbows to lower yourself again with control.

exercises.name: JM Press (Barbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold the bar with a grip slightly narrower than shoulder width.
Lower the bar towards your upper chest and chin by bending your elbows and letting them drift forward.
Press it back up to straight arms. Use light weight while learning the path.

exercises.name: Tate Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding the dumbbells over your chest with your palms facing your feet.
Bend your elbows out to the sides to lower the dumbbells until they touch your chest.
Extend your arms back up.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl (Barbell)
instructions: Sit with your forearms on your thighs, holding a barbell underhand with your wrists past your knees.
Let the bar roll down towards your fingertips.
Curl your wrists up as far as you can, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit with one forearm on your thigh, palm up, holding a dumbbell.
Lower the dumbbell by bending your wrist back.
Curl it up as high as you can, then switch hands after the set.

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curl (Barbell)
instructions: Sit with your forearms on your thighs, holding a barbell overhand with your wrists past your knees.
Lift the back of your hands up towards you as far as you can.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit with one forearm on your thigh, palm down, holding a dumbbell.
Raise the back of your hand as far as you can, then lower slowly.
Switch hands after the set.

exercises.name: Wrist Roller (Other)
instructions: Hold a wrist roller with both hands at shoulder height, arms straight in front of you.
Turn the handle, one hand at a time, to wind the weight up to the bar.
Unwind slowly to lower it. One full wind up and down is one rep.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk (Dumbbell)
instructions: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand and stand tall.
Walk forward with short, controlled steps, keeping your shoulders back.
Log the weight per hand and count each length walked as one rep.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk (Kettlebell)
instructions: Pick up a kettlebell in each hand and stand tall.
Walk with short steps, keeping your torso upright and your grip tight.
Count each length walked as one rep.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk (Trap Bar)
instructions: Step into a loaded trap bar and stand up with it as in a deadlift.
Walk forward with controlled steps and a tight grip.
Set it down with a flat back. Count each length as one rep.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar overhand with your hands about shoulder width apart.
Hang with straight arms and relaxed legs.
Hold for as long as you can keep a firm grip.

exercises.name: Plate Pinch (Plate)
instructions: Pinch two smooth plates together between your fingers and thumb, with the smooth sides facing out.
Stand tall and hold them at your side.
Hold for as long as you can, then switch hands.

exercises.name: Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Rest the bar across your upper back and step out of the rack with your feet about shoulder width apart.
Brace your stomach, then sit down between your hips by bending your knees and hips together.
Go as low as you can with a neutral back, ideally until your hips are below your knees.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand tall.

exercises.name: Front Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders with your elbows high, using a clean grip or crossed arms.
Keep your chest up and squat down between your knees.
Stand back up, keeping your elbows high so the bar does not roll forward.

exercises.name: Pause Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Set up as for a back squat.
Squat down to your normal depth and hold the bottom position for two to three seconds while staying tight.
Drive back up without bouncing.

exercises.name: Box Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Place a box behind you at a height where your thighs are about parallel to the floor when seated.
Unrack the bar and sit back onto the box under control.
Pause briefly without relaxing, then drive back up to standing.

exercises.name: Overhead Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Hold the bar overhead with a wide snatch grip and your arms locked.
Keep the bar over your mid-foot and squat down as deep as your mobility allows.
Stand back up while pushing the bar up into your hands.

exercises.name: Zercher Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Hold the bar in the crook of your elbows against your body.
Keep your torso upright and squat down.
Drive back up to standing.

exercises.name: Landmine Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest with both hands.
Squat down, keeping your chest up and the bar close.
Stand back up.

exercises.name: Squat (Smith Machine)
instructions: Position the bar on your upper back and place your feet slightly in front of the bar.
Unhook the bar and squat down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Push back up and re-hook the bar at the end of the set.

exercises.name: Squat (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at each side and stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down, keeping your chest up and your heels on the floor.
Stand back up.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands under the top end.
Squat down between your knees, keeping your elbows inside your knees.
Stand back up, keeping your chest tall.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Kettlebell)
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at chest height.
Squat down with your chest up until your elbows reach the inside of your knees.
Stand back up.

exercises.name: Air Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your arms in front of you.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Stand back up.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down a little, then jump explosively straight up.
Land softly and go straight into the next squat.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other leg held straight out in front of you.
Squat down on the standing leg as low as you can while keeping your balance.
Stand back up. Hold a support or squat to a box while you build strength.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
instructions: Stand with a very wide stance.
Shift your weight to one side and squat down on that leg while the other leg stays straight, toes up.
Push back up to the middle and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Hold onto a support and stand with your feet hip width apart.
Rise onto your toes and lean back as you bend your knees forward towards the floor.
Keep your hips straight and go as low as you can, then push back up.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
instructions: Lean your back flat against a wall and slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees over your ankles.
Hold the position for time.

exercises.name: Hack Squat (Machine)
instructions: Stand on the platform with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the pads.
Release the safety handles and squat down until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
Push back up through your feet, then lock the safeties when done.

exercises.name: Pendulum Squat (Machine)
instructions: Stand on the platform with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the pads.
Squat down as deep as you can while keeping your heels down.
Drive back up to the start.

exercises.name: Belt Squat (Machine)
instructions: Attach the belt around your hips and stand on the platform.
Squat down with an upright torso, holding the handles for balance.
Stand back up.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with your feet shoulder width apart in the middle of the platform.
Release the safeties and lower the platform until your knees are bent about 90 degrees or more.
Press the platform back up without locking your knees hard.
Keep your lower back against the pad throughout.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Leg Press (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the leg press and place one foot in the middle of the platform.
Lower the platform under control, then press it back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Leg Extension (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine's pivot and the pad sits on your lower shins.
Straighten your legs until they are fully extended.
Lower the weight slowly.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Leg Extension (Machine)
instructions: Set up in the leg extension machine with one leg under the pad.
Straighten that leg fully, then lower slowly.
Switch legs after the set.

exercises.name: Spanish Squat (Band)
instructions: Loop a heavy band around a sturdy post and step into it so it sits behind your knees.
Walk back until the band is tight and sit down, keeping your shins vertical.
Hold or pulse in the bottom position, then stand back up.

exercises.name: Lunge (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell at each side.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push off the front foot to return to standing, then alternate legs.

exercises.name: Lunge (Barbell)
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back.
Step forward and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.

exercises.name: Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push back to standing and alternate legs.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at each side.
Step one foot back and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive through your front foot to return to standing, then alternate.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge (Barbell)
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back.
Step back and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through your front foot to return, then alternate legs.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at each side.
Step forward into a lunge, then bring your back foot through into the next lunge.
Keep moving forward, alternating legs. Each step counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Stand tall and step forward into a lunge.
Push off and step straight into the next lunge with the other leg.
Keep your torso upright as you travel forward.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand with your feet together.
Take a big step to the side and sit back over that leg, keeping the other leg straight.
Push back to the start and alternate sides.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet together.
Step wide to one side and sit your hips back over that foot while the other leg stays straight.
Push back to standing and alternate.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at each side.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other and lower into a lunge.
Return to standing and alternate legs.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand a stride in front of a bench and rest the top of your back foot on it.
Hold a dumbbell at each side and lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Drive back up through your front foot. Finish the set, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and place your back foot on a bench behind you.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push back up, then switch legs after the set.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set the smith bar on your upper back and place a bench behind you for your back foot.
Unhook the bar and lower until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Press back up and switch legs after the set.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with the top of your back foot resting on it.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push back up, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Split Squat (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at each side and stand in a long split stance.
Lower your back knee towards the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push back up without moving your feet, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Step-Up (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand facing a box or bench holding a dumbbell at each side.
Place one foot fully on the box and drive through it to stand up on top.
Step back down with control. Alternate legs or finish one side first.

exercises.name: Step-Up (Barbell)
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and face a sturdy box.
Step up with one foot and drive through it to stand on the box.
Step down slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Step-Up
instructions: Face a box or bench.
Step up with one foot and push through that heel to stand on top.
Step back down and alternate legs.

exercises.name: Box Jump
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box with your feet hip width apart.
Swing your arms and jump onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand tall, then step back down.

exercises.name: Broad Jump
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Swing your arms back, bend your knees, then jump forward as far as you can.
Land softly in a squat, then walk back and reset.

exercises.name: Thruster (Barbell)
instructions: Hold the bar in the front rack position on your shoulders.
Squat down, then drive up hard and use that momentum to press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulders as you go into the next squat.

exercises.name: Thruster (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at each shoulder.
Squat down, then stand up explosively and press the dumbbells overhead.
Bring them back to your shoulders and go into the next rep.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with a shoulder-width grip.
With soft knees, push your hips back and lower the bar along your legs, keeping your back flat.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings, usually just below the knees.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells along your legs with a flat back.
Stand back up by squeezing your glutes.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Kettlebell)
instructions: Hold a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Hinge at your hips with soft knees until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand up.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Hinge forward at your hips as your free leg extends straight behind you.
Lower until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, then return to standing. Switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift (Kettlebell)
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg.
Hinge forward, letting your free leg rise behind you, keeping your hips level.
Return to standing and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift (Barbell)
instructions: Stand with the bar in front of your thighs and your knees only slightly bent.
Hinge forward and lower the bar towards the floor, keeping your legs nearly straight and your back flat.
Return to standing by driving your hips forward.

exercises.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your knees nearly straight.
Hinge forward to lower the dumbbells as far as your hamstrings allow with a flat back.
Stand back up.

exercises.name: Good Morning (Barbell)
instructions: Rest a light barbell across your upper back.
With soft knees, hinge forward at your hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat, then return to standing.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl (Machine)
instructions: Lie face down on the machine with the pad just above your heels and your knees just off the bench.
Curl your heels towards your glutes.
Lower slowly until your legs are straight.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pad behind your lower calves and the thigh pad snug.
Curl your legs down and back as far as you can.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Standing Leg Curl (Machine)
instructions: Stand at the machine with the pad behind one ankle.
Curl your heel towards your glute.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after the set.

exercises.name: Leg Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with a dumbbell held between your feet.
Curl your heels towards your glutes.
Lower slowly, keeping a firm grip with your feet.

exercises.name: Leg Curl (Band)
instructions: Anchor a band low in front of you, lie face down and loop it around your ankles.
Curl your heels towards your glutes against the band.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel with your ankles anchored under something solid or held by a partner.
Keep your body straight from knees to head and lower yourself forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands, then push back up to the start.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
instructions: Set up on a glute-ham bench with your feet against the plate and knees just behind the pad.
Lower your torso forward until your body is parallel to the floor.
Pull yourself back up by curling your heels into the plate.

exercises.name: Sliding Leg Curl
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on sliders or a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels towards your glutes, then slide them back out slowly while keeping your hips up.

exercises.name: Stability Ball Leg Curl (Other)
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Roll the ball towards you by bending your knees, then roll it back out.

exercises.name: Suspension Leg Curl (Suspension)
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the foot cradles under the anchor.
Lift your hips and curl your heels towards your glutes.
Extend your legs back out slowly while keeping your hips up.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded bar over your hips.
Plant your feet hip width apart and drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Finish with your body in a straight line from shoulders to knees, squeezing your glutes.
Lower your hips back down under control.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and hold a dumbbell on your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with your upper back on the pad and the belt or pad across your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set a bench beside the smith machine and sit with the bar padded over your hips.
Unhook the bar and drive your hips up until your torso is level.
Lower slowly and re-hook when done.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and your feet flat on the floor.
Drive your hips up until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes, then lower.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
instructions: Set up as for a hip thrust, then lift one foot off the floor.
Drive through the planted heel to raise your hips.
Lower slowly and switch legs after the set.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge (Barbell)
instructions: Lie on your back with a padded barbell across your hips and your knees bent.
Drive your hips up, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Lower back to the floor with control.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell on your hips.
Lift your hips by driving through your heels.
Pause at the top and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight.
Push through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Lower slowly and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Frog Pump
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out to the sides.
Push through the outsides of your feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback (Cable)
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and secure it around one ankle.
Hold the frame for support and kick that leg straight back, squeezing your glute.
Return slowly and switch legs after the set.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback (Machine)
instructions: Set up in the kickback machine with your foot on the platform or pad.
Push your leg back until your hip is fully extended.
Return slowly and switch legs after the set.

exercises.name: Donkey Kick
instructions: Start on your hands and knees.
Keeping your knee bent, lift one leg until your thigh is in line with your body.
Lower slowly and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrant
instructions: Start on your hands and knees.
Lift one bent leg out to the side until your thigh is about level with your hips.
Lower slowly and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing (Kettlebell)
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hike the bell back between your legs, then snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let it fall back between your legs and go straight into the next swing.
The power comes from your hips, not your arms.

exercises.name: Swing (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold one dumbbell by its end with both hands.
Hinge to swing it back between your legs, then drive your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let it swing back and repeat.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through (Cable)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from it, holding the rope between your legs.
Walk forward until there is tension, then hinge back at your hips.
Drive your hips forward to stand up tall, squeezing your glutes.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell between your legs.
Squat straight down, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Stand back up, squeezing your glutes.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads on the outside of your knees.
Push your legs apart as far as you can.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Cable)
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and secure it around the ankle farther from the machine.
Stand tall and lift that leg out to the side.
Return slowly, then switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Band)
instructions: Sit with a band looped just above your knees.
Push your knees apart against the band.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Lateral Band Walk (Band)
instructions: Place a band around your legs just above your knees or ankles.
Squat slightly and take steps to the side, keeping tension on the band.
Walk the same number of steps back the other way.

exercises.name: Clamshell (Band)
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and a band just above them.
Keeping your feet together, open your top knee as far as you can.
