Lower slowly and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked.
Raise your top leg towards the ceiling, keeping your toes pointing forward.
Lower slowly and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads on the inside of your knees.
Squeeze your legs together.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction (Cable)
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and secure it around the ankle closer to the machine.
Pull that leg across in front of your other leg.
Return slowly, then switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side and rest your top foot or knee on a bench, with your forearm on the floor.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line, supported by your top leg and forearm.
Hold for time, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
instructions: Stand with the pads on your shoulders and the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform.
Lower your heels as far as you can.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can, pause, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Smith Machine)
instructions: Put a step under the smith bar and rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with the balls of your feet on the step and lower your heels.
Rise as high as you can, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at each side and stand with the balls of your feet on a step.
Lower your heels below the step, then rise onto your toes.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Barbell)
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand with your feet hip width apart.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly back down.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step and hold a support for balance.
Lower your heels below the step, then rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on one foot on a step, holding a support with the other hand.
Lower your heel, then rise onto your toes.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pad on your lower thighs and the balls of your feet on the platform.
Lower your heels as far as you can.
Push up onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a plate or step and dumbbells resting on your knees.
Lower your heels, then raise them as high as you can.
Pause at the top and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Calf Press (Machine)
instructions: Sit in a leg press with the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform and your legs straight.
Release the safeties and let your toes come towards you.
Push the platform away by pointing your toes, then return slowly. Keep the safeties close.

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Rest on your forearms and toes with your elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels and brace your stomach.
Hold for time without letting your hips sag or rise.

exercises.name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side and prop yourself up on one forearm with your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold for time, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and feet a little apart.
Lift one hand to tap the opposite shoulder while keeping your hips still.
Alternate sides. Each tap counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor with your arms reaching overhead.
Hold the position for time. Bend your knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: L-Sit
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars or the floor with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight out in front of you until they are level with your hips.
Hold for time. Tuck your knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by tightening your stomach, keeping your chin off your chest.
Lower back down slowly.

exercises.name: Crunch (Cable)
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing it, holding the rope beside your head.
Crunch down by curling your ribs towards your hips.
Return slowly without letting your hips move back.

exercises.name: Crunch (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine and hold the handles or place your arms on the pads.
Curl your torso forward and down by tightening your stomach.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Decline Crunch
instructions: Lie back on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Curl your shoulders up towards your knees.
Lower back down slowly.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and your legs raised.
Bring one elbow towards the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Switch sides in a pedalling motion. Each side counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent at 90 degrees and lifted.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet anchored or flat.
Sit all the way up until your chest is near your thighs.
Lower back down slowly.

exercises.name: Decline Sit-Up
instructions: Lie back on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Sit up until your chest comes towards your knees.
Lower back down slowly.

exercises.name: Sit-Up (Weighted)
instructions: Lie on your back holding a plate against your chest, knees bent and feet anchored.
Sit up until your chest is near your thighs.
Lower back down slowly.

exercises.name: V-Up
instructions: Lie flat with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Lift your legs and torso at the same time and reach for your toes, forming a V.
Lower back down slowly.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Keeping your legs straight, raise them until they are at least level with your hips.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Bring your knees up towards your chest.
Lower them slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Knee Raise (Captain's Chair)
instructions: Support yourself on the forearm pads of a captain's chair with your back against the pad.
Raise your knees towards your chest.
Lower them slowly.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips.
Raise your legs until they are vertical, keeping your lower back on the floor.
Lower them slowly without touching the floor.

exercises.name: Toes-to-Bar
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Swing your legs up and touch your toes to the bar.
Lower with control and reset before the next rep.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout (Other)
instructions: Kneel on the floor holding an ab wheel under your shoulders.
Roll the wheel forward slowly, keeping your back from arching.
Go as far as you can control, then pull back to the start using your stomach.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Lift your feet if you can and rotate your torso to touch the floor beside each hip.
Each side counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Russian Twist (Weighted)
instructions: Sit leaning back slightly, holding a plate or medicine ball at your chest.
Rotate your torso from side to side, bringing the weight beside each hip.
Each side counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Woodchopper (Cable)
instructions: Set a pulley high and stand side-on to it, holding the handle with both hands.
Pull the handle down and across your body to the opposite hip, rotating through your torso.
Return slowly. Switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Woodchopper (Cable)
instructions: Set a pulley low and stand side-on to it, holding the handle with both hands.
Pull the handle up and across your body to above the opposite shoulder.
Return slowly and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (Cable)
instructions: Set a pulley at chest height and stand side-on to it, holding the handle at your chest.
Press the handle straight out in front of you and resist the pull to rotate.
Bring it back to your chest. Switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (Band)
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on to it, holding the band at your chest.
Press your hands straight out and hold briefly without rotating.
Return to your chest and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms pointing up and your knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Lower one arm overhead and the opposite leg towards the floor while keeping your lower back flat.
Return and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee towards your chest, then quickly switch legs.
Keep your hips low. Each knee drive counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Flutter Kick
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and lifted a little off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, quick movements.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor. Each kick counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Heel Touch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your shoulders slightly lifted.
Reach side to side to touch each heel with the hand on that side.
Each touch counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Side Bend (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Bend sideways towards the dumbbell, then return to upright using the opposite side of your waist.
Switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Side Bend (Cable)
instructions: Stand side-on to a low pulley holding the handle in the near hand.
Bend away from the machine, then return slowly.
Switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Landmine Rotation (Barbell)
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar with both hands at arm's length in front of you.
Rotate the bar down to one hip by turning your torso and pivoting your feet.
Bring it back over the middle and across to the other hip. Each side counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Dragon Flag
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head.
Lift your whole body until only your upper back touches the bench, keeping it straight from shoulders to toes.
Lower slowly without bending at the hips.

exercises.name: Windshield Wiper
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides and your legs raised straight up.
Lower your legs to one side as far as you can control, then bring them back up and over to the other side.
Each side counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a heavy dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Walk forward while staying upright, without leaning towards the weight.
Switch hands each length. Count each length as one rep.

exercises.name: Body Saw (Suspension)
instructions: Put your feet in the foot cradles and get into a forearm plank.
Push your body back by moving at your shoulders, then pull forward again.
Keep your hips level throughout.

exercises.name: Pike (Suspension)
instructions: Put your feet in the foot cradles and get into a high plank.
Lift your hips towards the ceiling while keeping your legs straight.
Lower back to the plank slowly.

exercises.name: Knee Tuck (Suspension)
instructions: Put your feet in the foot cradles and get into a high plank.
Pull your knees towards your chest.
Extend your legs back to the plank.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Slam (Medicine Ball)
instructions: Stand holding a slam ball overhead.
Slam it down into the floor in front of you as hard as you can, bending at the hips.
Pick it up with a flat back and repeat.

exercises.name: Rotational Throw (Medicine Ball)
instructions: Stand side-on to a solid wall holding a medicine ball at your hip.
Rotate through your hips and torso to throw the ball into the wall.
Catch it on the rebound and repeat. Switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Get on your hands and toes with your knees bent and hovering just off the floor.
Crawl forward by moving opposite hand and foot together.
Keep your back flat and hips low. Log the time.

exercises.name: Neck Curl (Plate)
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench with your head off the end, holding a light plate on your forehead with a towel under it.
Lower your head back slowly, then curl your chin towards your chest.
Move slowly and use very light weight to start.

exercises.name: Neck Extension (Plate)
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your head off the end, holding a light plate against the back of your head with a towel.
Lower your chin towards your chest, then lift your head back up until it is in line with your body.
Move slowly and start light.

exercises.name: Lateral Neck Flexion (Plate)
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench with your head off the end, holding a light plate against the side of your head with a towel.
Lower your head towards the floor, then lift it towards your shoulder.
Switch sides after the set. Use very light weight.

exercises.name: Neck Extension (Band)
instructions: Anchor a band at head height and loop it around the back of your head while facing away from the anchor.
Step forward for tension and nod your head back against the band.
Return slowly. Keep the movement small and controlled.

exercises.name: Power Clean (Barbell)
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and grip it just outside your legs.
Lift the bar to mid-thigh, then extend your hips and knees explosively and shrug.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on the front of your shoulders in a partial squat.
Stand up tall, then lower the bar back down.

exercises.name: Hang Clean (Barbell)
instructions: Stand holding the bar at mid-thigh with a shoulder-width grip.
Hinge slightly, then drive your hips forward explosively and shrug.
Pull under the bar and catch it on your shoulders, then stand up.

exercises.name: Clean and Jerk (Barbell)
instructions: Clean the bar from the floor to the front of your shoulders and stand up.
Dip and drive the bar overhead, splitting your feet front and back to catch it on locked arms.
Bring your feet back together, then lower the bar.

exercises.name: Power Snatch (Barbell)
instructions: Grip the bar wide and set up over your mid-foot with a flat back.
Lift the bar to your hips, then extend explosively and pull yourself under it.
Catch it overhead on locked arms in a partial squat, then stand up.

exercises.name: Clean Pull (Barbell)
instructions: Set up as for a clean with the bar over your mid-foot.
Lift the bar to mid-thigh, then extend your hips and knees explosively while shrugging hard.
Let the bar come back down under control.

exercises.name: High Pull (Barbell)
instructions: Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a shoulder-width grip.
Extend your hips explosively and pull the bar up to chest height with your elbows high and out.
Lower it back to your thighs.

exercises.name: Snatch (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell on the floor between your feet.
Hinge to grab it with one hand, then drive your hips forward explosively.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body and punch it overhead to a locked arm.
Lower it back down and switch hands as needed.

exercises.name: Snatch (Kettlebell)
instructions: Swing a kettlebell back between your legs with one hand.
Drive your hips forward and guide the bell up close to your body, punching your hand through to lock it overhead.
Lower it back into the next swing. Switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Clean (Kettlebell)
instructions: Swing a kettlebell back between your legs with one hand.
Drive your hips forward and guide the bell up so it lands softly in the rack position at your shoulder.
Lower it back into a swing and repeat. Switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Clean and Press (Kettlebell)
instructions: Clean the kettlebell to the rack position at your shoulder.
Press it overhead to a locked arm.
Lower it to the rack, then back into a swing for the next rep.

exercises.name: Burpee
instructions: From standing, squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a push-up position and lower your chest to the floor.
Push up, jump your feet back towards your hands and leap up with your arms overhead.

exercises.name: Wall Ball (Medicine Ball)
instructions: Stand facing a wall holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down, then drive up and throw the ball to a target high on the wall.
Catch it and go straight into the next squat.

exercises.name: Sled Push (Other)
instructions: Load a sled and hold the upright handles with your arms extended.
Lean in and drive the sled forward with short, powerful steps.
Log the sled load and count each length pushed as one rep.

exercises.name: Battle Ropes (Other)
instructions: Hold an end of the rope in each hand with your knees slightly bent.
Make fast alternating waves by moving your arms up and down.
Keep going for the planned time.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out wide while raising your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start. Each full jack counts as one rep.

exercises.name: High Knees
instructions: Run in place, driving your knees up to hip height.
Pump your arms and stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for the planned time.

exercises.name: Jump Rope (Other)
instructions: Hold the rope handles at hip height with the rope behind your heels.
Turn the rope with your wrists and make small jumps as it passes under your feet.
Keep going for the planned time.

exercises.name: Running
instructions: Run at your planned pace with relaxed shoulders and a steady breathing rhythm.
Land with your feet under your hips rather than out in front.
Log the distance and the time.

exercises.name: Sprint
instructions: Warm up thoroughly before sprinting.
Run at close to full speed for the planned distance, driving your arms and knees.
Walk back or rest fully between sprints. Log the distance and time for each.

exercises.name: Walking
instructions: Walk at a brisk, steady pace.
Keep your posture tall and swing your arms naturally.
Log the distance and the time.

exercises.name: Hiking
instructions: Walk a trail at a steady pace, shortening your stride on climbs.
Use poles if the terrain is steep or uneven.
Log the distance and the time.

exercises.name: Treadmill Running (Machine)
instructions: Start the belt at a walking pace and build up to your running speed.
Stay near the front of the belt and avoid holding the handrails.
Log the distance and the time shown on the display.

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Walk (Machine)
instructions: Set the treadmill to a steep incline and a brisk walking speed.
Walk tall without leaning on the handrails.
Log the distance and the time.

exercises.name: Cycling (Other)
instructions: Ride at your planned effort, keeping your knees tracking in line with your feet.
Adjust the saddle so your leg is nearly straight at the bottom of each pedal stroke.
Log the distance and the time.

exercises.name: Stationary Bike (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your leg is nearly straight at the bottom of each pedal stroke.
Pedal at your planned resistance and cadence.
Log the distance and the time from the display.

exercises.name: Air Bike (Machine)
instructions: Sit on the fan bike with your hands on the moving handles.
Push and pull the handles while pedalling, matching the effort of your arms and legs.
Log the distance and the time.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine (Machine)
instructions: Strap your feet in and grip the handle with straight arms.
Push with your legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your lower ribs.
Reverse the order to return: arms, then body, then legs. Log the distance and the time.

exercises.name: Elliptical (Machine)
instructions: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
Move in a smooth stride at your planned resistance.
Log the distance and the time.

exercises.name: Stair Climber (Machine)
instructions: Step onto the machine and choose a steady speed.
Climb with your whole foot on each step and keep your posture upright, holding the rails only lightly.
Log the time.

exercises.name: Ski Erg (Machine)
instructions: Stand facing the machine and grip the handles overhead.
Pull the handles down by hinging at your hips and driving your arms towards your thighs.
Stand back up to reset. Log the distance and the time.

exercises.name: Swimming (Other)
instructions: Swim at a steady pace using your preferred stroke.
Breathe in a regular rhythm and keep your body long in the water.
Log the distance and the time.

exercises.name: Leaning Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a sturdy upright with one hand and lean away from it, holding a dumbbell in the other hand.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side until your arm is level with your shoulder.
Lower it slowly, then switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Behind-the-Back Lateral Raise (Cable)
instructions: Set a pulley at the lowest position and stand side-on to it with the cable running behind your back to the far hand.
Raise that arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly, then switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Cable Y-Raise (Cable)
instructions: Set two pulleys at the lowest position and cross the cables, holding the left cable in your right hand and the right in your left.
Raise your arms up and out into a Y shape above your head.
Lower them slowly back across your body.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Cable)
instructions: Place a bench between two low pulleys and sit holding a handle at each shoulder.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding one dumbbell at your shoulder.
Brace your stomach and press it overhead without leaning to the side.
Lower it slowly, then switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Overhead Carry (Kettlebell)
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead and lock your arm with your bicep beside your ear.
Walk forward slowly, keeping your ribs down and the bell stacked over your shoulder.
Switch arms each length. Count each length as one rep.

exercises.name: Behind-the-Back Shrug (Barbell)
instructions: Hold a barbell behind your thighs with an overhand grip, using a rack or partner to pick it up.
Shrug your shoulders straight up as high as you can.
Pause, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Shrug (Kettlebell)
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders straight up towards your ears.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Overhead Shrug (Barbell)
instructions: Press a light barbell overhead with a wide grip and lock your arms.
Shrug your shoulders up towards your ears while keeping your arms straight.
Lower them slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Prone Trap Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding light dumbbells with your arms hanging down.
Raise your arms forward and up at an angle, thumbs up, by pulling your shoulder blades down and back.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Hip Adduction
instructions: Lie on your side with your top leg bent and its foot planted in front of your bottom knee.
Keep your bottom leg straight and lift it off the floor.
Lower it slowly, then switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Adductor Squeeze (Other)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and a ball or rolled towel between them.
Squeeze your knees together as hard as you can for a few seconds.
Relax and repeat. Each squeeze counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction (Band)
instructions: Anchor a band low beside you and loop it around the ankle nearer the anchor.
Pull that leg across in front of your other leg.
Return slowly, then switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Kayak Row (Cable)
instructions: Attach a long bar to a high pulley and stand facing it, holding the bar wide with straight arms.
Pull one end of the bar down towards your hip, as if paddling, then return to the middle.
Alternate sides. Each side counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms and an overhand grip.
Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulder blades down and together so your body rises slightly.
Lower back to a full hang slowly.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Chest Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell over your chest.
Lower it to the side of your chest while keeping your hips and shoulders level.
Press it back up, then switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Spider Curl (EZ Bar)
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench, holding an EZ bar with your arms hanging straight down.
Curl the bar up, keeping your upper arms vertical.
Lower it slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Lying Cable Curl (Cable)
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor or a bench with your feet towards a high pulley and hold a straight bar overhead.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the bar towards your forehead.
Return slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Lying Triceps Extension (Cable)
instructions: Lie on a bench with your head towards a low pulley, holding a bar or rope over your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower your hands towards your forehead.
Extend your arms back up without moving your upper arms.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step, holding a support for balance.
Lower your heel below the step.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can, then lower slowly. Switch legs after the set.

exercises.name: Oblique Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and let them fall to one side.
Crunch your shoulders up towards the ceiling.
Lower slowly, then switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Side Plank Hip Dip
instructions: Get into a side plank on your forearm.
Lower your hips towards the floor without touching it.
Lift them back up past straight, then switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Stir the Pot (Other)
instructions: Get into a plank with your forearms on a stability ball.
Move your forearms in small circles, keeping your hips still.
Each circle counts as one rep. Change direction halfway through.

exercises.name: Sled Drag (Other)
instructions: Attach a strap or rope from the sled to a handle and face the sled.
Hold the handle and walk backwards with short steps, staying low.
Log the sled load and count each length as one rep.

exercises.name: Wide-Stance Leg Press (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the leg press and place your feet wide and high on the platform, toes turned out.
Lower the platform until your knees are bent about 90 degrees, pushing them out.
Press back up without locking your knees hard.
